title: Shadowrocket production architecture
description: Canonical top-level stages. Everything else is control-plane, guardrail, or dormant experiment — not additional production stages.

stages.name: 全自动启动开关
stages.role: Global gate. When enabled, Watchdog may auto-dispatch; when held, production stays idle.

stages.name: 看门狗
stages.role: Sole scheduler: read switch, evaluate fingerprint/queue, issue task + resource lease, dispatch pipeline.

stages.name: 采集
stages.role: Discover candidate sources and capture observations. Non-activating.

stages.name: 筛选
stages.role: Conflict sync, lineage, candidate matrix, admission, domain collection.

stages.name: 审查
stages.role: Deterministic domain audit against policy and sources; build DIRECT/PROXY/REJECT sets; read-only gates.

stages.name: 发布
stages.role: Sole write boundary: publish allowlisted ruleset outputs and independently verify remote results.

pipeline.execution_note: Stages 3–5 currently run as one sequential job (audit) under a single resource lease; stage 6 is a separate privileged job. Independent job split is a later structural change and must preserve lease, artifact, and pin invariants.

not_architecture_stages.role: Dormant independent collect DAG until authorized

invariants: modules/uu.conf is owner-managed read-only for all stages
Only stage 6 may write production ruleset outputs
Watchdog is the only authorized dispatcher for production
Stage 1 switch defaults unknown modes to hold
